notes:
Top-lines: 1) Enterprise healthtech, strict PHI-like rules, cannot send unredacted patient data outside their VPC. 2) Customer asking for Redwood Private (VPC) POC — full deploy inside their AWS account via Terraform modules + Helm charts.

Discovery call notes (2026-01-10):
- Intro with CTO (L. Martinez) + Head of Data (S. Osei). They run analytics on de-identified EHR and want low-latency summarization and embeddings for research UI.
- Primary concern: data residency & cryptographic key control. "We need KMS we control; no token or secret should leave our account."
- Compliance: SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred, audit trails mandatory for model inputs/outputs for 7 years (per legal).

POC ask (agreed):
- Deploy Redwood Private control plane (customer-managed) + inference nodes in customer VPC (us-east-1) using provided Terraform modules.
- Helm charts to install inference runtime into their EKS cluster.
- Integrate AWS KMS CMKs for model encryption and runtime key retrieval. Demo KMS rotation and access audit.
- Audit logging forwarded to their Splunk instance (via syslog/CloudWatch subscription).
- SSO with Okta using SAML for Console access; RBAC mapping for AE/SE/ops roles.
- Acceptance criteria: can serve chat + embeddings with configured quantized model; 95th percentile p50/p95 latency under 250ms/500ms for small chat payloads; full audit logs for each request; no outbound internet egress from nodes except to allowed control plane endpoints.

POC runbook / timeline (short):
- 2026-02-01: Initial infra access granted (IAM role assumed; account-share).
- 2026-02-05: Terraform plan applied in staging VPC (SE Jordan Lee led).
- 2026-02-10: Helm charts installed to EKS; KMS key policy pushed; initial smoke tests pass (health endpoints OK).
- 2026-02-15: Integration call + demo (Fireflies ff-20260215-verdant-demo). Walkthrough of audit logs flowing to Splunk.
- 2026-02-20: Security team ran static review; asked for KMS policy change and proof of key access logs (ticket INFRA-2217).
- 2026-02-25: Perftest run (embeddings throughput 120 req/s sustained; chat median latency ~160ms, p95 ~420ms).

Customer quotes: "We can't allow any model input to leave our network without explicit logging and consent metadata attached." — Head of Data.

Open technical notes / risks:
- KMS integration: need to demonstrate the call flow where Redwood runtime retrieves ephemeral key material without storing plaintext keys. Security asked for threat model doc.
- Data residency: customer requires EU footprint for EU research team; will want separate POC there after US sign-off.
- Audit logging retention: they want 7 years; discuss cost + Rollup/PII redaction policies.

Next immediate actions (AE/SE):
- Jordan to update Terraform modules to expose KMS policy outputs + example IAM role for key usage (owner: Jordan).
- Send security artifact bundle (SOC2 brief, network diagram, KMS threat model) to security@verdantsentry by 2026-03-03. Drive links provided above.
- Schedule legal sync the week of 2026-03-08 to close data-residency clause.

Sales notes: high strategic value — potential to expand to Dedicated capacity for inference across hospital partners. Close plan: target decision by 2026-06.
